title: Local pure tensor in ordinary etale scalar extension
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme, $A,B$ commutative rings, $\varphi:A\to B$ a unital ring homomorphism, and $M$ a sheaf of $A$-modules on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Let $E_{\varphi,T}$ be ordinary sheaf scalar extension, $R_{\varphi,T}$ restriction of scalars, and $\eta:M\to R_{\varphi,T}E_{\varphi,T}M$ the unit of their specified scalar adjunction [def-sf-etale-sheaf-scalar-extension]. For every etale test object $S$, section $x\in M(S)$ and element $b\in B$, define the local pure tensor $x\otimes b\in (E_{\varphi,T}M)(S)$ to be $b\cdot\eta_{M,S}(x)$, reading the unit value in the underlying $B$-module. No flatness or finiteness condition is imposed.
